note: Renumbering decision records: three traps, all measured while absorbing main into a campaign branch whose 0120 collided with one that had landed. (1) render decisions writes to STDOUT, not to docs/digest/decisions-in-force.md. Run it directly and you get correct content printed and an untouched artifact; regenerate-artifacts.sh owns the redirect. (2) Renumbering DOWN overlaps source with target -- 0127 becomes 0124, which is another record own old number -- so both the git mv sequence and any sed rules must run ASCENDING. Descending, the 0127 record lands on 0124 and a later rule drags it again to 0121, silently. (3) A bare number grep is dangerous: searching for 012 followed by 4-7 also matches 0.0126 in another campaign retrospective, where it is a STANDARD DEVIATION rather than a cite. Key every rewrite on a filename stem or a named file, never on a bare number across the tree, or you corrupt somebody else measurement in prose with nothing to catch it. And the completeness check that actually works: decision_cites_in_sources_resolve plus all_knowledge_doc_links_resolve going green is mechanical proof no cite dangles, which beats re-reading your own grep list.
